about: EEDCS-11, TEST ONLY: the observation hooks tools/build-observed-windows.sh adds to a temporary copy of crates/eech-engine-sys/build/patches.rs, after the product patches. Each keeps its original text and adds one call into tools/arrival-observe/eech_arrival_observe.c. Never part of a product build.

patches.why: The verdict of check_guide_reached_waypoint for every server guide update, passed through unchanged; for a SUPPLY task's waypoint or one of the four SUPPLY types it is reported, and the WAYPOINT_REACHED notification is bracketed as one span of consequences.

Counts each entity index's generation (how often it has been freed), so that an observed entity is named by [index, generation] across EECH's index reuse; reports the freeing of an entity an earlier event named.
Reports each SUPPLY task when create_supply_task has built it: its cargo type, supplier, requester and waypoints.
patches.replacement:
set_local_entity_float_value (new_task, FLOAT_TYPE_TASK_USER_DATA, get_local_entity_int_value (cargo, INT_TYPE_ENTITY_SUB_TYPE));

	{ extern void eech_observe_supply_task_created (entity *task, entity *requester, entity *supplier, entity *cargo); eech_observe_supply_task_created (new_task, requester, supplier, cargo); } /* EECH observe (A3), test only */

patches.why: Reports a SUPPLY task receiving TASK_COMPLETED, with the termination reason it was sent.
patches.replacement:
task_terminated = (task_terminated_types) va_arg (pargs, int);

	{ extern void eech_observe_task_completion_request (entity *task, int terminated); eech_observe_task_completion_request (receiver, (int) task_terminated); } /* EECH observe (A4), test only */

patches.why: Reports a SUPPLY task's completion state being set (to failure, partial or success), whatever path sets it.
patches.replacement:
raw->task_completed = value;

         { extern void eech_observe_task_completed_set (entity *task, int sub_type, int value); eech_observe_task_completed_set (en, raw->sub_type, value); } /* EECH observe (A5), test only */
